_: The rootworm network lists the places where the Underground Express calls and marks which of them join. AUTHORED (16g deliverable 6, rule 5); `python3 -m worldgen.travel_services` re-sites each node at its place's `positionM` and rebuilds `rootways[]` and the service's hops. It also gives every node its Waykeeper slot. A node whose `placeId` is still null stays `placeholder` on its pass-1 point; the derive does not invent a position. `kind` is `hub` (many rootways meet), `station` (a stop on one) or `seasonal` (the way is open only part of the year; quests 20 section 12b: Gideon is not a standing station).

stations.why: The Hist heartland is where the rootways meet; the hub node waits on the Helstrom hero-Hist siting.
The northern call of the express; the place is chosen with the northern hero Hist.
The southern deep call of the express; the place is chosen with the southern hero Hist.
The eastern estuary call of the express; the place is chosen with the eastern hero Hist.
